object: prospective discovery of a method-operator class omitted from the incumbent RAKL method basis
benchmark_objective: Separate noticing that the incumbent basis is insufficient from correctly identifying a useful missing operator and transferring that operator to a fresh surface realization without answer leakage or self-authorization.

blocking: false method-basis-gap claims on incumbent-solvable worlds = 0
nonblocking: cost per correctly identified operator family

matched_baselines: structured audit plus independently qualified outside view

capability_shaping_contract.model_strength_amplified: candidate generation, relational abstraction, and hypothesis recombination
capability_shaping_contract.weakness_constrained: surface-cue matching, ontology lock-in, self-confirmation, and answer leakage
capability_shaping_contract.smallest_compensator: sealed evaluator-side operator witness plus fresh-transfer world and explicit epistemic-cut contract
capability_shaping_contract.verification_oracle: precommitted evaluator that checks hidden-label isolation, cut localization, resolution evidence, and fresh transfer
capability_shaping_contract.typed_handoff: METHOD_BASIS_GAP_CANDIDATE -> OPERATOR_FAMILY_PROPOSAL -> SEALED_RESOLUTION_CHECK -> FRESH_TRANSFER_CHECK -> proposal-only evidence packet
capability_shaping_contract.resource_delta: record model calls/tokens/tool calls/latency; matched baselines must share ceilings

six_role_review.finding: A discovery claim must survive far or surface-shifted transfer; solving one familiar-looking world is insufficient.
six_role_review.failure_condition: operator proposal succeeds only when target surface cues resemble the development world

six_role_review.finding: Gap detection, epistemic-cut identity, and missing-operator identity are distinct variables; an ontology extension cannot be scored from a generic failure flag.
six_role_review.failure_condition: multiple inequivalent operator families remain compatible with the observed residual

six_role_review.finding: Retrieval may supply candidate operator families but cannot see evaluator-only labels or count as proof that a candidate resolves the hidden world.
six_role_review.failure_condition: retrieved terminology leaks the hidden operator label or answer key

six_role_review.finding: The sealed world must contain a discriminating cut where the incumbent basis is insufficient and the held-out operator family makes a different resolvable prediction or action.
six_role_review.failure_condition: incumbent and challenger are observationally indistinguishable on all frozen probes

six_role_review.finding: Candidate diversity is exploration value only; the evaluator must reward a resolving operator rather than novelty of wording.
six_role_review.failure_condition: novel but non-resolving operator proposals receive positive discovery credit

six_role_review.finding: Same-orchestration role separation is not independent review; independent credit requires process/context and evidence-lineage independence.
six_role_review.failure_condition: same-context critique is counted as independent assurance

hostile_worlds.purpose: do not invent a method operator for missing observations
separate code failure from method-basis gap
choose evidence that separates surviving operator families
freeze candidate semantics before answer reveal
taxonomy cannot stand in for mechanism/operator witness
one-world fit is not transferable discovery
benchmark success cannot mint scientific target truth
fail closed when evaluator witness is unavailable

acceptance_rule: A richer discovery scaffold may be considered a Class B improvement only if, under matched resources, it improves at least one registered nonblocking meta-QoI while preserving all blocking meta-QoIs. Synthetic support-code conformance alone cannot establish real missing-operator discovery utility.
main_falsifier: If the simpler structured metacognitive audit or generic reflection baseline matches the richer scaffold on correctly identified operator families, fresh transfer, false-positive suppression and cost, preserve the simpler incumbent and record the null.
